metadata.title: Solissia
metadata.description: Solissia, the food sourcing specialist (fruit and vegetables, food products): we find reliable producers, negotiate and secure your international purchases and sales.

home.hero: solissia is the food sourcing specialist

intro.lead: Solissia finds, negotiates and secures your international purchases and sales.
paragraphs: Buying and selling abroad means juggling the unknown: finding a reliable supplier or customer, confirming they actually exist and checking that the business opportunity is real.
Solissia takes care of all of this. We manage these steps for you, while you keep the final say at every key stage.

slides.title: Verified suppliers, at the source
slides.text: We identify growers and check that they exist and have the capacity you need before you commit.

slides.title: From harvest to your warehouse
slides.text: Negotiation, quality control and logistics tracking: we manage every step through to delivery.

sourcing.title: Solissia, sourcing experts
paragraphs: Our Purchasing and Quality teams join forces to select outstanding partners. Our goal: to guarantee flawless harvests while meeting strict environmental and social responsibility standards.

To find the best fruit, we search the whole world. When the ingredients our formulations need don't grow in France, Solissia sources them where climate and growing conditions are ideal, while supporting the local economy.

custom.title: Tailored solutions
paragraphs: Rigorous selection of our supplies is the cornerstone of our model. We constantly seek out the finest raw materials to guarantee you flawless quality. By being uncompromising about where our products come from, we supply exceptional ingredients that live up to your own standards.

imageAlts.hero: Fresh fruit and vegetables: radish, squash, persimmon, avocado, quince and turnip
imageAlts.sourcing: Ripe oranges on an orange tree

lines: Personal data collected on the website www.solissia.com is processed by Merci Immobilier (hereinafter “Solissia”), registered with the Perpignan Trade and Companies Register (RCS) under SIREN number 852 226 620, with its registered office at 7 avenue de Banyuls-sur-Mer, 66100 Perpignan, France.

blocks.heading: Contact form
lines: Subject, first name, last name, email address, phone number (optional) and message, in order to answer your request. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in handling the requests sent to us and, where applicable, pre-contractual measures taken at your request.

blocks.heading: User account
lines: Email address and password (stored in encrypted form by our authentication provider), in order to give you access to your account. Legal basis: performance of the service you request by creating an account.

blocks.heading: Technical data
lines: When you visit, technical data (IP address, browser type, pages viewed) is processed by our hosting provider to run and secure the website. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in providing a reliable and secure website.
Your data is intended only for the Solissia staff in charge of handling your request. It is never sold or rented. We use the following technical providers, which process it on our behalf:
items: Supabase Inc.: database, user account authentication and storage of article images, hosted in the European Union (Stockholm, Sweden).
Resend (United States): sending notification emails when a message is sent through the contact form.
after: When data is transferred outside the European Union, these transfers are covered by appropriate safeguards, in particular the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

items: Contact messages: 3 years from our last exchange.
User account: as long as the account is active; the data is deleted when the account is closed.
Technical data: according to our hosting provider's log retention periods.

lines: The website uses no audience measurement or advertising cookies.

Only strictly necessary cookies are set: one that remembers the language you chose and, when you sign in to your account, cookies that keep you signed in. They serve no other purpose. Under the applicable rules, these cookies do not require consent. Session cookies are deleted when you sign out or when they expire.
You can set your browser to block cookies at any time; you will then no longer be able to sign in to your account.

Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the French Data Protection Act, you have the following rights over your data: access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, objection, portability, as well as the right to withdraw your consent at any time and to set instructions regarding your data after your death.
To exercise these rights, write to us at alami@solissia.com or by post at 7 avenue de Banyuls-sur-Mer, 66100 Perpignan, France. We will reply within one month.
If you believe your rights are not being respected, you can lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority (www.cnil.fr).
We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data: encrypted connections (HTTPS) and access restricted to authorised staff only.
To learn more about the website publisher, see our [legal notice](/legal). The French version of this policy prevails.
